title: Women's health
description: Reproductive history, asked of women only: questionnaire Section C, Women's health.

menarche_age.title: Age at first menstrual period (years)
menarche_age.$comment: Source coding: integer 8-20; -6 Not applicable; -9 Don't know. Notes: Women only. Questionnaire C1: 'How old were you when you had your first menstrual period?' People whose sex was refused hold -6 here, like men (D021).

parity.title: Number of live births
parity.$comment: Source coding: integer 0-15; -6 Not applicable; -9 Don't know. Notes: Women only. Questionnaire C2: 'How many live births have you had?' People whose sex was refused hold -6 here, like men (D021).

age_first_birth.title: Age at first live birth (years)
age_first_birth.$comment: Source coding: integer 14-50; -6 Not applicable; -9 Don't know. Questionnaire C3: 'How old were you at your first live birth?' The dictionary has no 'Women only' note on this row; the questionnaire asks all of Section C of women only (¶13). The data steward says women with no live births hold -6 here (D020), as do people whose sex was refused (D021).
age_first_birth.x-universe: Women with at least one live birth (sex = 2 and parity 1 or more)

breastfed_ever.title: Ever breastfed
breastfed_ever.$comment: Source coding: 1=Yes; 2=No; -6 Not applicable; -9 Don't know. Questionnaire C4: 'Did you ever breastfeed any of your children?' The dictionary has no 'Women only' note on this row; the questionnaire asks all of Section C of women only (¶13). The data steward says women with no live births hold -6 here (D020), as do people whose sex was refused (D021).
breastfed_ever.x-universe: Women with at least one live birth (sex = 2 and parity 1 or more)
